long_description:
By popular demand, CVGCA proudly brings you TWO unforgettable nights of Authentic Garba & Dandiya!

📅 Oct 10 & Oct 17, 2026

📍 Mountain House High School

For over a decade, families across the Central Valley, Bay Area & Tri-Valley have made CVGCA Garba their home for enjoying Navratri tradition.

Join us for two spectacular evenings of authentic Garba & Dandiya with live singers, live orchestra, authentic Dhol, beautiful décor, vibrant ambience, delicious food, & the warm hospitality that has made CVGCA one of the Bay Area’s largest and most well-attended open-air Navratri celebrations.

🎉 Early Bird Special – only until July 27th 

🎟️ Buy 10 Combo Passes & Get 1 FREE!
